project_info.theme: Cinematic close-up portrait covered with intricate botanical face patterns
project_info.creative_direction: Painterly oil-paint realism combining ornamental floral skin art, one bold red eye shape, and vintage teal atmosphere
project_info.color_palette: teal, botanical green, muted red, warm skin, charcoal hair, and soft vintage shadows

main_subject.detail: adult woman with calm direct gaze, natural facial texture, dark sculpted hair, and intricate botanical patterns painted across the face and skin
main_subject.face_art: ornamental floral and leaf patterns with one bold red artistic shape around one eye

composition_elements.framing: tight close-up portrait with the face as the central anchor
composition_elements.background: teal vintage studio background with soft atmospheric depth
composition_elements.surface: detailed painterly botanical texture that follows facial planes without obscuring eyes or identity

lighting_and_atmosphere.type: dramatic soft studio key at approximately 4600K with controlled side fill
lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: sculpted face, visible ornamental texture, gentle shadow depth, and cinematic color separation

technical_specs.render_style: full-frame camera with 85mm portrait lens, painterly oil-paint realism
technical_specs.finish: ultra-detailed ornamental texture, natural pores, shallow depth of field, cinematic grading, and restrained grain

prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a close-up cinematic portrait of a clearly adult woman whose skin is covered with intricate botanical floral and leaf patterns, with one eye marked by a bold red artistic shape. Use painterly oil-paint realism while preserving natural facial texture, clear eyes, and realistic anatomy. Place the adult subject against a teal vintage studio background with dramatic soft approximately 4600K lighting, controlled side fill, shallow depth of field, ultra-detailed ornamental textures, cinematic color grading, and a fine-art editorial mood. Keep the face fully recognizable, the patterns non-violent and decorative, and the image free of logos, text, or celebrity likeness.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexual pose, fetish framing, ambiguous age, body horror, wounds, blood, celebrity likeness, watermark, logo, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, HDR look, extra fingers, deformed face, muddy floral pattern
